table.note: Docs micro-run row. 20%=$0.01 < floor $0.02 but cap $0.015 < floor, so clamp yields $0.015 (30%). Unconstrained floor would have been $0.02 = 40%.

Floor boundary. 66667 micros is the nearest integer micro to 1/15 USD (0.02/0.30), on the floor side. 20% < $0.02 and 30% = $0.0200001 ≥ $0.02, so floor binds at $0.02. 4-decimal display rounds cap 0.0200001 → 0.02; effectiveFeePercent toFixed(2) is 30 because 0.02/0.066667 ≈ 29.99985%. Binding is floor, not cap.
